ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure, there are three ideal current sources connected in parallel between the same pair of upper and lower nodes. The left current source is labeled 2A, with the arrow upward; the middle current source is labeled 3A, with the arrow upward; the right current source is labeled 1A, with the arrow downward. On the right side, an equivalent current source I is drawn, with its reference arrow upward.
